geometry: 14 by 14 canvas with a partially transparent black background and a one-unit square-cornered gray waveform stroke spanning x=2 to 12 and y=2 to 12. Source background alpha is 166/255 except corners near 128/255; waveform is gray 142 with alpha 206/255. A vector mask keeps waveform and background alpha independent.
limitations: The lightly rounded background corners approximate the source's reduced corner alpha. Native and 8x renders were visually inspected.
qt5_compatibility: Rewritten without <mask>, <clipPath> or <filter>, which Qt5's SVG renderer ignores: masked gradient products became 1px strips, clips became hard-stop gradients or even-odd paths, and blur became stacked translucent shapes.
